blurb: Guests can rent jet skis, single and double decker pontoon boats, and join guided dolphin tours by jet ski or boat. Tours and rentals include safety briefings, life jackets, and local guides. Some tours offer wildlife viewing including dolphins, sea turtles, and birds.
extraNote: Reservations strongly recommended at least 48 hours ahead for pontoons · Prices subject to change and blackout dates around major holidays · No tubing allowed off pontoons for safety reasons · No outside alcohol allowed on sunset dolphin tours; adult beverages available for purchase · Plan to arrive early for check-in and safety briefing · Walk-ups accepted when equipment is available · Multiple docks in Destin Harbor and across from Crab Island; exact location depends on rental or tour booked.
